proof_summary: For the candidate linear-recurrence sequence, the error \(D_n=c_{n+1}^2-c_{n+2}c_n\) satisfies \(D_{n+3}=4D_{n+1}+D_n\), and growth estimates inductively give \(0<D_n\le c_n\). Thus \(c_{n+2}c_n<c_{n+1}^2\le(c_{n+2}+1)c_n\), which makes \(c_{n+2}\) exactly the integer selected by the ceiling rule and hence identifies the nonlinear sequence with the linear one by induction.
